summary: A township’s long naming project reaches the committee as a group of creeks on a single motion.
realLife: The federal committee approved eight creek names from the township’s outreach project in one vote. The Pennsylvania register gives each creek its own feature number and the same June decision date.
inGame: needs: the list of streams covered by the motion and the decision on grouping them.

turns.what: The chair puts the group to a vote.
turns.pulledBy: Members agree to a single motion.
turns.writesBack: The minutes record one disposition for the listed streams.

turns.what: The chair asks for separate consideration.
turns.pulledBy: A member singles out a disputed name.
turns.writesBack: The disputed stream gets its own motion.
